archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) mixed with Tech Accents

components.navbar: Sticky, top-0, z-50. Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/5. Links on right, Logo left. Use optical alignment.
components.buttons: Primary: bg-accent_blue text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,102,255,0.4)] transition-all font-semibold. Secondary: bg-surface border border-border text-white hover:bg-surface_elevated.
components.cards: bg-[#141414] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-8 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-accent_blue/30 transition-all duration-300
components.contact_form: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Textarea. bg-[#141414] with border-white/5. Focus states must use border-accent_blue and ring-accent_blue/20.

motion.scroll_reveal: Use framer-motion. initial opacity-0 y-10 to opacity-100 y-0 with spring transition.
motion.stagger_children: Delay 0.1s per item in grids (Skills, Process)

media.description: Abstract black ribbed texture against dark background for subtle cinematic hero background. Use with heavy opacity overlay (bg-black/80).
Young creative man in black hoodie holding his chin. Use in About section.
Dark UI mockup for the Premium Pitch project.
Black and white soccer ball for the cinematic sports visuals of the Premium Pitch project.

accessibility.testing_attributes: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast over dark backgrounds meets APCA guidelines. Explicit hover states on text.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement entirely in pure HTML and Tailwind CSS for major layouts; use Shadcn for the Contact Form and complex interactive elements.
Apply Framer Motion for subtle entry animations and hover states. Do NOT over-animate.
Ensure 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' fonts are loaded via Google Fonts in index.html or global css.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) or lucide-react for UI icons (skills, process steps, social).
Build a 5-step creative process timeline layout, making it visually distinct from generic lists.
The 'Premium Pitch' project must combine both the UI mockup image and the cinematic soccer ball image creatively, like overlapping absolute positioned elements or a split bento card.
Implement MongoDB connection logic in the backend for the Contact form. Ensure form visually displays bryandelgado.web.design@gmail.com.
Make sure all images use object-cover and are highly responsive.
Avoid standard Bootstrap-style columns, use modern bento grids or overlapping layouts as defined in E1 Designer guidelines.
